description: This file implements a Kubernetes CSR (Certificate Signing Request) garbage collection controller that automatically deletes old or expired CSRs based on specific criteria such as status, age, and certificate expiration.

classes.name: CSRCleanerController
classes.description: A controller that garbage collects old Kubernetes CSRs based on status and age criteria.

methods.name: NewCSRCleanerController
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CSRCleanerController with provided CSR client and informer.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the CSR cleaner controller with specified number of worker threads.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Processes CSR list, handling each CSR for potential deletion.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Determines if a CSR should be deleted based on various age and status criteria.

methods.name: isIssuedExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CSR's issued certificate has expired.

methods.name: isPendingPastDeadline
methods.description: Checks if a pending CSR has exceeded its allowed age.

methods.name: isDeniedPastDeadline
methods.description: Checks if a denied CSR has exceeded its allowed age.

methods.name: isFailedPastDeadline
methods.description: Checks if a failed CSR has exceeded its allowed age.

methods.name: isIssuedPastDeadline
methods.description: Checks if an approved CSR with a certificate has exceeded its age limit.

methods.name: isApprovedUnissuedPastDeadline
methods.description: Checks if an approved CSR without a certificate has exceeded its age limit.

methods.name: isOlderThan
methods.description: Utility to check if a timestamp is older than a specified duration.

methods.name: isIssued
methods.description: Determines if a CSR has an issued certificate.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the certificate in the CSR has expired based on NotAfter date.
